answer_1.quote: We combine OCR-assisted visual information with the language understanding capabilities of LLMs, AutoHDR achieves precise localization and restoration of damaged text... we adopt Qwen2, an advanced LLM, as our backbone model, specializing it in historical text prediction...

answer_2.quote: For damaged content prediction, Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy metrics are adopted... For appearance restoration, we adopt the commonly used Accurate Rate (AR) as our evaluation metric... we use LPIPS for pixel-level evaluation on synthetic data.

answer_4.quote: We conduct two user studies (Style Consistency and Overall Quality) with 20 participants to evaluate restoration quality... historians to evaluate a randomly selected set of 30 samples, achieving an F1 score of 97.2%.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to score font style similarity on a 1-5 scale for style consistency, and to consider font style similarity, background integration, and character accuracy when selecting the best overall result.
criteria: Overall Quality (font style, background integration, character accuracy)
